findings.location: task.errors[id=e2].feedbackUk: «Haciendo — герундій, він іде після estar.»
findings.description: Ukrainian «герундій» denotes a verbal noun. Applying it to the Spanish adverbial form gerundio is a false-friend grammatical term under rule 8.
findings.suggestion: Use «дієприслівник (gerundio)» and describe estar + gerundio as one of its uses.

items.notes: The answer key is correct. The visible model is permitted for a supported task.
sources: RAE/ASALE, Nueva gramática de la lengua española, chapter 27, gerundio (from memory).
